Oil prices rose above $100/barrel as a result, and while they have partially retraced on peace-deal hopes, recalibration of shipping channels and the overhang of potential future closure will keep near-term supply-demand dynamics elevated.

This obviously impacted energy markets quite dramatically, given the fact that 20% of oil was not flowing, and this is a vital artery for the flow of that production, which ultimately has a pretty dramatic effect on the global economy.
